checks.detail: event 2026-11-11 is 9 days before detection on 2026-11-20 (limit 60)

issues: The summary and key dates are accurate (11/11/2026 committee referral in Parliament, 1st reading; 09/09/2026 legislative proposal COM(2026)0590; stage 'Awaiting committee decision'; committee dossier IMCO/10/06606; procedure 2026/0265(COD)), but the labelled interpretation introduces facts absent from the source: it asserts that the procurement rules 'touch recycled and refurbished content' and refer to 'green procurement criteria'. The source only lists amendments/repeals of instruments (e.g. Directive 2008/98, Regulation 2024/1781, Regulation 2025/40) and says nothing about recycled/refurbished content or green procurement criteria, nor about which actors (recyclers, converters, brand owners) are affected.
The interpretation's causal/strategic claim that committee-stage amendments will be 'more decisive than later plenary votes' is speculation not present in the procedure file.
